caption: The drawing depicts a group of human figures engaged in a scene centered around a man dressed in a long light robe and a crown of thorns, bent over while carrying a large, dark brown wooden cross on his shoulder. Flanking this central figure are several individuals, some of whom wear red garments and red pointed hats with white stripes, suggesting officials or soldiers, with one holding a rope attached to the central figure. Another man in a red tunic supports the end of the cross. To the left, two women are shown, one in a dark green and black robe holding a child, and another in a reddish-pink garment, looking towards the central figure. In the background, three figures with halos outlined in blue and gold are present, possibly angels or holy women, depicted with calm expressions and long garments of white, blue, and red. The background is filled in with dark brown and green hues suggesting earth or a rocky landscape. The entire composition is framed by a beige margin and presented in a rectangular format. The use of colors is mostly earthy with highlights of red, pink, blue, green, and gold.
title: Stations of the Cross No. 8: "Jesus Speaks to the Women of Jerusalem"
